assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full painted background terrain for a Chinese wuxia RPG forest map, landscape 1600:1100.
Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its luminous detailed hand-painted Jiangnan stonework, foliage, turquoise natural stream, rock banks, little waterfalls, painterly game textures and camera angle. Input image 2 is a STRICT LAYOUT SKETCH, not finished art: preserve the spatial road network and river route; replace all flat diagram shapes with beautiful natural terrain.
Create a FINISHED detailed elevated overhead 2D game map, with NO horizon. This forest is directly south of the village from image 1. Clearly defined WALKING TRAILS should be narrow weathered grey-beige cobblestone footpaths with irregular individual stones, worn edges, moss between stones, compact dirt at shoulders, framed by small raised stone banks, dense short ferns and grassy hummocks. The connected paths in sketch are approximately 80-100 world units wide, NEVER broad merged sand fields. Keep path centers open, visually unmistakable, and keep all junctions readable. Only the upper-left clinic forecourt is spacious, about 420 by 270 world units.
Follow image 2 precisely: beige is connected WALKABLE route geometry, green is NONWALKABLE dense forest/shrub/rock-bank space, cyan is the river, brown marks two future bridge crossing decks, grey at upper-left is the future building footprint.
The stream must look NATURAL and fully hand-painted like image 1: curving rock-lined banks, layered smooth stones, reeds, grasses, white wildflowers, translucent jade turquoise water with visible pebbles under shallow edges, foam and tiny cascades between moss-covered rocks. No straight canal, no flat polygon water, no drawn contour line, no repeating wave dashes. Keep its central water footprint close to sketch so bridges land correctly. No stepping stones that suggest walking across water.
Grey footprint upper-left: a raised foundation of weathered stone paving, with a few stone steps DOWN at its lower edge, EMPTY with no building because a separate clinic sprite will cover it. In front, a modest spacious cobblestone forecourt and a bamboo-lined walkway connected to main path. Do not draw an actual house.
Green islands: richly varied low shrubs, roots, mossy nonmetallic rounded boulders, little rocky ledges with small steps ONLY outside paths, fern beds, wildflowers, some bamboo stands along far left perimeter. Tall dense tree crowns only on OUTER margins, keep main inner paths unobscured because tree sprites are separately layered. Use soft organic trail edges rather than geometrically cut circles or large blank plazas. Several tiny mineral prospecting alcoves along the paths, but NO ore rocks or metallic veins, no harvestable herbs: separate sprites will be added.
Brown rectangles are locator guides ONLY. Do NOT paint bridge planks, rails or fences there; paint continuous water and natural open landing stones for separately layered bridges at exactly these crossings. No fences anywhere in background (fences added as sprites), no buildings, no people, no animals, no UI, no labels, no lettering, no watermark.
It must look like the same artist and world as image 1, detailed, inviting, readable, not a diagram and not a texture collage.

notes: Style reference is the original village map. Trail and river collision data are calibrated to the final painted image. Superseded by forest-v4.png, which extends roads to both map edges.
